title: Search for an irreducible binary modulus
statement: For a natural number $\ell$, search the vectors in $(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^\ell$ for one that passes the binary monic irreducibility test. Return the first such vector if one exists, and return no vector otherwise.
